rules.response: Welcome to Healing Wave Hospital. How can I assist you today?
Our hospital is open 24/7 for emergencies. General outpatient and administrative hours are 8 AM to 8 PM, Monday to Saturday.

To find a doctor, please specify the department or the doctor's name. We have specialists in Cardiology, Pediatrics, Emergency Medicine, Orthopedics, and many more. You can also use our 'Find a Doctor' tool on our website.

To book an appointment, please specify the department or type of specialist you need, and your preferred date/time. You can also schedule online via our patient portal or call our appointments desk at [Hospital Appointments Phone Number, e.g., +91-422-XXXX-XXXX].
You can contact our main reception at [Hospital Main Phone Number, e.g., +91-422-XXXX-XXXX] or visit our official website for department-specific contact details.
For medical emergencies, please come directly to our Emergency Department, which is open 24/7. If you are experiencing a life-threatening emergency, please call 108 immediately.
Healing Wave Hospital is located at [Hospital Address, e.g., 123 Health Ave, Gandhipuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, 641012]. Detailed directions and a map are available on our website.
For billing or insurance inquiries, please contact our billing department at [Billing Department Phone Number] during business hours, or log into our patient portal to view your statements.
Our in-house pharmacy is located on the ground floor and is open from 8 AM to 9 PM daily. You can collect your prescriptions here.
Visitor hours vary by department. Generally, visitor hours are from 10 AM to 12 PM and 5 PM to 7 PM. Please check with the specific ward for details.
To inquire about test results, please contact your referring doctor's office directly, or you may be able to access them through our secure patient portal.
We value your feedback. Please visit the 'Contact Us' section on our website for our feedback form, or ask to speak with a patient relations representative.
For admission inquiries, please proceed to the patient registration desk. For discharge information, your care team will provide you with all necessary details.
Interested in joining our team? Please visit the 'Careers' section on the Healing Wave Hospital website to view current job openings and apply.
